column1: # Name-based classification for products the source did not categorise.
# Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the cleaned product name
# tried IN FILE ORDER — the first match wins. Order: personal care & household
# so "Dairy Milk Chocolate" is a chocolate and "Butter Cookies" are biscuits.
# Keep patterns word-bounded (\b) to avoid substring hits.
